A-SSCC 2025

IEEE Asian Solid-State Circuits Conference
 

November 2-5, 2025

Daejeon Convention Center (DCC), Daejeon, South Korea

The IEEE A-SSCC (Asian Solid-State Circuits Conference) is an international forum for presenting the most updated and advanced chips and circuit designs in solid-state and semiconductor fields.
The conference is supported by the IEEE Solid-State Circuits Society.



IEEE A-SSCC 2025 will be held in Daejeon, Korea on November 2-5, 2025


The conference will start with a one-day tutorial session on November 2 and plenary talks is scheduled at the start of the main program,

November 3 through 5. The main program includes contributed presentations, panel discussion, Student Design Contest exhibition and FPGA demo sessions.

Important Dates

Paper submission due: June 4, 2025, June 18, 2025, 20:00 (GMT)

Acceptance notification: August 9, 2025

Final paper submission: September 1, 2025
